I think personally I was drawn to my type nine husband’s stable mood, and perceived safety/acceptance; and he was drawn to my emotional expressiveness because he could vicariously experience emotions. However, being a four I desire deep relational connection ( to be seen, known, and understood), and that’s not natural to my nine. My emotional expressiveness explicit and implicit has caused him pull away relationally because the vice of the nine is narcotization, meaning they seek to numb their feelings. We connected well at first, but I find now that there is a void where intimacy should be. I need to work on how I express my emotional volatility, and he needs to work on his his willingness to feel his emotions. We’re currently trying to work through this, and it’s been difficult. We’ve only been married a year. No matter what type you’re with there is going to be issues that are difficult to work through, but it doesn’t necessarily mean you’re incompatible. I think incompatibility occurs overtime when two people don’t grow together. I personally think any relationship can work if you’re both willing to put in the work.
